name: Coming Out Kit
source:
Coming Out Kit follows Kit, a non-binary teenager, as they come out to the people they love most in this world. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231227030732/https://shatteredreality.itch.io/cok]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
